author: obijobi
body:
I'm not sure why but for some reason somebody believed i was hacking. Even worse i was banned for flying which is very easy to look like its happening when there a bit of lag. i have an old bad computer it runs on OSX 10.6.5 I also don't have great internet and as if it couldn't get any worse my computer is on the other end of the house to the router. I don't hack and really want to be unbanned That was one of my favourite servers. after i was banned i had a few things happen and stopped playing minecraft for a while. If it makes any difference i was even beginning to considering donating after all the time i spent playing. also if you need to know I was banned by Sundaye on the 29th of October 2014 12:33:59 pm GMT

Please consider

Cheers Obi
